network_verification.method: Python socket connect/connect_ex/create_connection/getaddrinfo blocked during model load and all predictions; native library packet traffic not measured

privacy.notice: Keep outputs local when using private cases. Default outputs contain case identifiers, text hashes and predictions, without original notes.

role.instructions: What role does {entity_name} have in this report? Select the most specific role supported by the text.

criteria.accused: Target is accused, investigated or convicted of wrongdoing; a conviction is a reported judicial outcome
criteria.victim: Target suffered wrongdoing committed by others
criteria.complainant: Target reported or denounced wrongdoing by others
criteria.incidental: Target is mentioned without involvement in the reported wrongdoing
criteria.negated: The target denies wrongdoing or the text explicitly negates the allegation
criteria.resolved: The case against the target was dismissed or target was acquitted by an authority
criteria.insufficient: No target mention, ambiguity, hypothetical allegations or contradictory roles prevent identifying a role
criteria.indirect: Target has only an indirect relationship to another entity involved in wrongdoing

protocol.abstain_rule: truncated or max option probability below threshold; experimental, uncalibrated

metrics.rss_measurement: current fresh process sampled after each note, not peak allocation or historical ru_maxrss

limitations: Small synthetic hand-labelled challenge set; no claim of real-world accuracy.
English checkpoint tested directly in Spanish, without translation.
Golden checks verify five token counts and predicted options, not all possible tokenizer inputs or full probability parity.
Model distributions are not calibrated risk probabilities for this task.
No NER, relation or evidence-span quality measured by this phase.
512 tokens include instructions/options; truncation is surfaced explicitly.
Model outputs do not contribute to the existing score.
